title: Башня большого эфира
description: A grand but friendly ivory radio citadel: central round tower, two smaller unequal towers, large elegant brass signal ring above the central dome, arched mint shutters, one coral pennant and three cypress trees. Broad two-tier limestone terraces with a sweeping pale road around the outer terraces; gradual curved ramps replace square stair turns. Make this the distinctive destination island without religious symbols or lettering.
